That's right, The Old Net has an IRC Channel!

What's even better is it's linked to our Discord channel with a bot. So now people on old and new computers can talk to each other!

If you are on a modern system you can use the Web Chat window above! Just click Connect!

Otherwise install your favorite IRC client. I use XChat. You can find some Windows 3.11 era clients here.

Connect to a server by typing: /server irc.oftc.net

Then connect to a channel by typing: /join #theoldnet
